name: Pauli X propagates through CNOT
summary: A Pauli X on the control of a CNOT becomes a Pauli X on both qubits.
description:
Pushing a Pauli X gate on the control qubit through a CNOT gate copies it to the target: $\mathrm{CNOT}\,(X\otimes I) = (X\otimes X)\,\mathrm{CNOT}$. In the ZX-calculus the π X-phase is copied through the Z-spider of the control by the [π-commutation rule](../pi-commutation/), and the copy on the target fuses into the X-spider there. With colours swapped (also shown on this page), a Pauli Z on the target is copied to the control.

Together with [phase commutation](../cnot-phase-commutation/), this gives all the rules for propagating Paulis through CNOT circuits, as needed in stabiliser simulation, measurement-based computation and error correction.
